latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — automate social lead generation with targeted search and scoring.

- Finds high-intent leads in live Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit conversations by searching for pain points, solution-seeking, and competitor complaints.
- Auto-researches your product, builds target audience/persona, and generates 12-18 targeted search queries.
- Uses SkillBoss API Hub to search and return relevant posts/users across platforms.
- Scores discovered leads, tiers them as Hot/Warm/Watchlist, and avoids duplicates.
- Outputs lead info, engagement data, custom outreach draft, and score rationale for user review.
